lines.text: The weather in GTA 6 felt stuck, and Rockstar's first patch just backed up the players who said so.
The notes say Rockstar fixed weather that did not change for extended periods.
So endless sunshine, or a storm that never ends, should finally cycle.
The patch also fixes crashes, autosave, and a wanted level you could not lose.
On PS5 it's only about six hundred megabytes.
Some players still report crashes, though, so it's just the first patch.
It shows Rockstar is listening, so tell us below, did you also notice that
